diaspora_bullets: Venues, fixtures and ticket details for 2029 and 2031 have not been announced
The next World Cup, in 2027, is hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia
hook_line: INDIA LANDS 2029 CHAMPIONS TROPHY AND 2031 WORLD CUP

hook_stat.sub: India hosts the Men's Champions Trophy from October 9 to 28

news_summary: The ICC Board, meeting in Bali, approved its men's events calendar through 2035: India hosts the Champions Trophy in October 2029 and co-hosts the 2031 Cricket World Cup with Bangladesh.
payoff: India are the tournament's current holders, so the 2029 edition is a home defence of the title.
